commit.message:
deploy: the dashboard names are intentional — declare them

Ryan confirmed the Render display names studio-810 and studio-810-staging
are deliberate, so deploy.config.json now declares them and the name drift
goes green. render.yaml keeps name: wearestudio810 on purpose — it is the
blueprint identity and the source of the onrender.com slug, and renaming a
blueprint service risks recreating it (new slug would break the pre-cutover
production URL); the header documents the split.

Also corrects the stale previews claims the deploy agent caught on its first
day: sources-of-truth.md and the render.yaml header both said previews were
enabled when the toggles are Off by choice. Both of that run's findings are
now resolved deliberately rather than silently.

Co-Authored-By: claude-flow <ruv@ruv.net>
